expected.fmt:
import expect_contains, expect_equal, expect_fault from "@std/test/test.ms"

interface Counter:
	var fn bump(by: Int) Int
	var fn lower(by: Int) Int

type Cell:
	total: Int

impl Counter for Cell:
	var fn bump(by: Int) Int:
		self.total += by
		return self.total

	var fn lower(by: Int) Int:
		self.total -= by
		return self.total

fn sum() Int:
	var cell = Cell(0)
	var i = 0

	while i < 1000:
		cell.bump(2)
		cell.lower(1)
		i += 1

	return cell.total

fn prefix() Int:
	var cell = Cell(9223372036854775807)
	var i = 0

	while i < 2:
		cell.bump(1)
		cell.lower(1)
		i += 1

	return cell.total

fn peer() Int:
	var cell = Cell(9223372036854775807)
	var other = Cell(0)
	var i = 0

	while i < 2:
		cell.bump(other.total)
		other.bump(1)
		i += 1

	return cell.total

fn scalar_peer() Int:
	var cell = Cell(9223372036854775807)
	var sum = 0
	var i = 0

	while i < 2:
		cell.bump(sum)
		sum += 1
		i += 1

	return cell.total

fn reset() Int:
	var cell = Cell(0)
	var i = 0

	while i < 2:
		cell.total = 9223372036854775807
		cell.bump(1)
		i += 1

	return cell.total

fn effect(var visits: List[Int]) Int:
	visits.append(7)
	return 1

fn eager(var visits: List[Int]) Int:
	var cell = Cell(0)
	cell.bump(effect(var visits))
	return cell.total

test "closed cell updates preserve each operation":
	sum() | expect_equal(1000)?

test "closed cells retain prefix overflow":
	(expect_fault(fn: _ignored := prefix())?) | expect_contains("Int overflow")?

test "peer cells and scalar carries are not initial invariants":
	(expect_fault(fn: _ignored := peer())?) | expect_contains("Int overflow")?
	(expect_fault(fn: _ignored := scalar_peer())?) | expect_contains("Int overflow")?

test "field resets keep ordinary overflow checks":
	(expect_fault(fn: _ignored := reset())?) | expect_contains("Int overflow")?

test "record arguments execute exactly once before the update":
	var visits: List[Int] = []
	eager(var visits) | expect_equal(1)?
	visits | expect_equal([7])?
